most_similar_reason: Candidate 8 shares the target's core pattern of a civilizing hero-deity who descends/appears among people, travels from place to place teaching and dispensing wisdom to those who come to him, is remembered in several conflicting versions, and leaves behind a sacred site with a sun temple and commemorative rites.
